title: Bijectivity of the affine tensor unit on affine base sections
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Write $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, let $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$ be the structure map, and let $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:f^{-1}\mathcal A\to\mathcal O_U$ be the structure map, inverse-image map, and ring inverse-image/direct-image counit. Write $R$ for pushforward as an $\mathcal A$-module, and $S$ for restriction to $\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Tensor pullback and change of rings are those of [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the adjunction is the canonical one of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $B$ be a commutative ring sheaf on $U$, $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$, $t:f^{-1}\mathcal A\to B$, and $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$. Let $P:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(B)$ and $H:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$ be functors, let $\kappa:P\operatorname{res}_b\simeq Sf^*$, $\gamma:Sf^*\to H$, $\beta:1\to HR$ be natural maps. Suppose $B,b,t,\epsilon,P,\kappa,H,\gamma,\beta$ satisfy the pushout, counit, change-of-rings object and map formulas, the formula for $\kappa$ on pullback units, the formula $\gamma(p)=1\otimes p$, preservation of quasi-coherence by $H$, and the equation $S\beta_G=\mathrm{adjoint}(\gamma_G)$. For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal A$-module $G$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every affine open $V\subseteq X$, the section map $\beta_{G,V}:G(V)\to H(G)(f^{-1}V)$ is bijective.

proof.text: Apply the affine tensor unit section presentation to obtain a surjective D-linear map q:C tensor_D N -> H(G)(W) with the given diagonal-action kernel and unit formula.

Define contraction a(c tensor n)=cn by the balanced linear tensor lift. It sends 1 tensor n to n and kills every diagonal-action relation, so ker(q) is contained in ker(a). If two unit tensors have the same q-image, contraction of their difference proves equality of their inputs. Every generator has q(c tensor n)=q(1 tensor cn); tensor induction extends this to q(z)=q(1 tensor a(z)). Surjectivity of q then proves that n -> q(1 tensor n) is surjective and hence bijective.

Expand the adjunction Hom equivalence as unit followed by pushforward of gamma. Evaluate hcomp at V and n. The section-presentation unit formula gives beta_V(n)=q(1 tensor n). Transfer injectivity and surjectivity along this equality.

theorem affine_module_tensor_unit_sections_bijective [IsAffineHom f]
     (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
      (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B) (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf)
    (hring : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t ∧ b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf ∧ t ≫ ε = e₀)
     (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (hP : (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app (fV V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app (fV V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                (fV V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj (fV V)) ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj (fV V),(t.hom.app (fV V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g))))
     (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
          (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
          (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H)
    (hH : (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
            H.map a = eqToHom (hobj G) ≫
              SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G) (P.map a) ≫
              eqToHom (hobj G').symm) ∧
          (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
              (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
            ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
              ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
                (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
                  ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W,(ε.hom.app W).hom] p)) ∧
          (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
            G.IsQuasicoherent → (H.obj G).IsQuasicoherent))
     (β : 𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) ⟶ H ⋙ R)
    (hcomp : ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
      (S).map (β.app G) = ((adj₀).homEquiv ((S).obj G) (H.obj G)) (γ.app G))
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherent)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    Function.Bijective ((β.app G).val.app (op V))
